title: Two Arsenals - which era faced the harder task?
question: Two Arsenal title teams, 22 years apart. Which era faced the harder task - and how well did each side meet it?
starting_fact: On the raw table the 2003/04 Invincibles were the more dominant league campaign: 90 points, unbeaten. This story is about the difficulty of the task each side faced, not which squad was more talented.

sources.2003/04: StatsBomb Open Data (Arsenal shot/xG events); final tables, squads and fixtures from Wikipedia.
sources.2025/26: Understat (per-match xG + player data); final tables, squads and fixtures from Wikipedia.

model: PoissonRegressor(goals ~ xG) -> independent-Poisson match outcomes -> expected points.
honesty_note: Every figure is tagged fact / measured / interpretation and never blended. Metrics without data for both eras are omitted or flagged, never fabricated.
